rules: Insurance or indemnity is not accountability.
Legal defense spending is not worker compensation.
Training procurement is not prevention verification.
A settlement is not system correction.
Public-service spending is not institutional cost internalization.
Recurrence must increase accountable burden rather than reset the training cycle.
